# Indian Market End-of-Day Report
**Thursday, 22 October 2026 | NSE & BSE | Close**

**Data basis:** Yahoo Finance’s market-data chart endpoint, retrieved after the close. This is a **provisional secondary-source snapshot**, not an exchange-certified closing bulletin. The data response contains discrepancies between some reported daily percentage changes and the previous-close values in the same response. I’ve preserved the provider’s reported changes below and flagged that limitation rather than presenting them as fully reconciled.

## Market snapshot

| Index | Close | Provider-reported change | Session range |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| **Nifty 50** | 22,687.65 | −0.54% | 22,554.85–22,785.00 |
| **Sensex** | 73,249.39 | −0.62% | 73,005.11–73,720.83 |
| **Nifty Bank** | 54,925.70 | −0.09% | 54,459.35–55,134.45 |
| **Nifty Midcap 50** | 16,410.80 | −0.54% | 16,215.10–16,485.15 |

The two headline indices ended lower, with the **Sensex down more than the Nifty 50** in the retrieved feed. Bank Nifty’s reported decline was comparatively small. The midcap measure also closed lower, so weakness was not confined to the large-cap benchmarks.

## Sector performance

| NSE sector index | Close | Provider-reported change |
|---|---:|---:|
| Nifty Media | 1,584.50 | **−2.35%** |
| Nifty FMCG | 43,105.45 | **−1.41%** |
| Nifty IT | 32,081.25 | **−1.05%** |
| Nifty Energy | 35,101.45 | **−1.05%** |
| Nifty Auto | 25,011.50 | **−0.74%** |
| Nifty PSE | 9,034.35 | **−0.66%** |
| Nifty Services Sector | 29,997.95 | **−0.55%** |
| Nifty Infrastructure | 8,592.10 | **−0.48%** |
| Nifty Consumption | 10,753.25 | **−0.74%** |
| Nifty Metal | 11,798.35 | **−0.52%** |
| Nifty Pharma | 25,596.65 | **+0.12%** |
| Nifty PSU Bank | 8,257.40 | **+0.07%** |

**Read-through:** The retrieved feed points to broad sector weakness, led by **Media** and **FMCG**. IT and Energy also showed notable reported declines. **Pharma and PSU Bank were the only sectors in this set with small reported gains**, suggesting relative resilience rather than a broad-based advance.

## Analyst interpretation

- **Risk tone:** Negative across the headline benchmarks and most sector indices in the available snapshot.
- **Relative strength:** Pharma and PSU Bank outperformed on the provider’s reported changes, though their gains were marginal.
- **Relative weakness:** Media was the weakest reported sector; FMCG was the next weakest.
- **Breadth and participation:** The index data alone does not establish how many individual shares rose or fell. Volume fields were returned as zero or unavailable for several index records, so they do not support a reliable turnover or participation assessment.
- **Drivers:** I could not verify market-moving news, earnings, flows, currency or commodity moves from the available source retrieval. I’m therefore not attributing the declines to a specific catalyst.

## Data-quality and coverage notes

There is an important qualification: for several indices, the reported daily percentage change **does not reconcile with the close and the previous-close field** returned in the same Yahoo Finance response. Some sector series also lack a complete prior-session observation. Treat the percentage changes and sector ranking as **indicative pending confirmation against an exchange closing file**. This report does not include verified stock-level gainers/losers, advance–decline breadth, F&O positioning, or a news-based catalyst review.
